answer.verdict: PAL widescreen regenerates the 6 config entries and flags both IPU words. US widescreen is documented only. F48F No-Interlacing is not a cheap safe switch: the SMODE2 change is a delay slot, so config/ghidra_export.toml was not edited and nothing was recompiled.

facts.c: tools/pnach_to_switch.py prints [patches] instructions with switch=, groups a [section] into one switch name, and flags branches, delay slots, skip/outside functions, replaced stubs, no-ops, and gsaspectratio/gsinterlacemode.

PAL SCES-50878_2251E14D against SCES_508.78 CRC 2251E14D accepted exactly the 6 widescreen address/value/switch tuples in config/ghidra_export.toml:345-351, in that order. Proof script printed PAL_MATCH True.
0x00292424 flagged as sceIpuStopDMA stub plus original branch. Range 0x002923B0-0x00292494.
0x00292628 flagged as sceIpuSync stub, delay slot of 0x00292624, and ELF already 0x00000000. Range 0x002925E8-0x00292650.
Emitter throws on a switch in a delay slot and on a patched branch/jump. A switch on the branch word itself is not applied.

US SLUS-20328_833FE0A4 against SLUS_203.28 CRC 833FE0A4 accepted 6 words: 0x00216EA0, 0x001F6BF8, 0x0018D408, 0x00200D84, 0x00200D88, 0x00200D94, same values as PAL. IPU 0x002917E4 and 0x002919E4 flagged as branches inside sceIpuStopDMA 0x00291770-0x00291854 and sceIpuSync 0x002919A8-0x00291A10. US toml has no [patches]. Tree not written.

F48F994A without --ignore-crc exits 2 (name CRC F48F994A, ELF 2251E14D). With --ignore-crc the No-Interlacing section accepts only 0x001E2254=0x24020002 and flags 0x0022B138 and 0x001EDC24 as delay slots plus gsinterlacemode=1.
0x0022B138 is the delay slot of jal FUN_0022af18 and sets a1 to the row index (4, patch wants 6). a0 is 0.
Mode table at 0x00321270 stride 6 in .rodata. Row4 01 03 02 00 d2 00 is interlace 1 omode 0x03. Row6 00 50 02 00 d2 00 is interlace 0 omode 0x50. Both halves at +2 are 0x0002.
sceGsResetGraph stub writes SMODE2=(interlace&1)|((ffmode&1)<<1). Call site passes ffmode=1. Row4 gives SMODE2 3. Row6 gives SMODE2 2. Height arg is 0x100 when omode==3 and 0x1C0 when omode==0x50.
fieldOffset is lround(scale) only when SMODE2 bit0 and bit1 are set and displayField==1. lineRepeat is doubled only then. That is the one-row bob at scale>1.
gsinterlacemode=1 is GSInterlaceMode::Off (Automatic=0, Off=1) and PCSX2 applies it only when the user mode is Automatic. ps2xRuntime has no reader of that setting.
0x001E2254 stores 2 instead of 1 at 0x0036E9ED. A walk of generated/*.cpp found that literal in only FUN_001e2210. It does not write SMODE2.
GS_MODE_NTSC=0x02, GS_MODE_PAL is the next enumerator (0x03), GS_MODE_DTV_480P=0x50.
F48 widescreen on v2.00 matches our six addresses except 0x0018D408 is 0x3C0143D6 not 0x3C0143D5. Not applied.
pal_us_map.py was not on disk. The three No-Interlacing sites already hold the unpatched opcodes on the v2.00 ELF, so no disc map was required.

contra: 0x001E2254 is emitter-legal as switch no_interlace. It was not added because it only changes the byte at 0x36E9ED and leaves SMODE2 interlaced.
0x00292628 is already 0 on this ELF, so the sceIpuSync pnach word is a no-op as well as a replaced delay slot.
On PCSX2, gsinterlacemode=1 forces deinterlace Off when the user setting is Automatic. Our bob is computed from SMODE2 in gs_hw_backend.cpp, which does not read that setting.

open: H:/tekken4-fork-ps2recomp/ps2xRecomp/src/lib/function_emitter.cpp:155 is not owned. A later no_interlace port has to allow a switch on a delay-slot instruction, then the word is { address = "0x0022B138", value = "0x24050006", switch = "no_interlace" }. That also sets omode 0x50 and height 0x1C0, so it needs a 2x shot before it is safe. Do not add 0x001E2254 alone.
A reader of 0x36E9ED that uses a base plus offset, and a later GIF write that sets SMODE2 back to 3, were not traced. Neither makes the delay-slot word switchable.
